newsitem.title: PANAMA: Bladex in $100 mln trade financing syndicate.
newsitem.headline: Bladex in $100 mln trade financing syndicate.

text.p: Banco Latinoamericano de Exportaciones (BLADEX) plans to launch a $100 million trade financing syndicate in December to finance short-term trade, first vice president Christopher Hesketh said.

Half of the transaction is totally underwritten, with the remaining 50 percent on a best effort basis, he told a news conference on Monday. Bladex officials are confident they will reach $100 million, he said.
The trade financing syndicate will be arranged by European institutions and investment banks for two years with a margin of 25 basis points.
Panama City-based BLADEX is a leading provider of trade financing and other trade related services in Latin America and the Caribbean.
